thread.title: Wall Street rises with Apple, easing trade fears

author: Reuters
title: Wall Street rises with Apple, easing trade fears
text:
Traders work on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York, U.S., September 12, 2018. REUTERS/Brendan McDermid More (Reuters) - Apple <AAPL.O> led a rebound in technology shares and boosted all three major U.S. stock indexes on Thursday, while trade worries eased after China welcomed new talks with the United States.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average <.DJI> rose 147.07 points, or 0.57 percent, to 26,145.99, the S&P 500 <.SPX> gained 12.56 points, or 0.43 percent, to 2,901.48 and the Nasdaq Composite <.IXIC> added 48.74 points, or 0.61 percent, to 8,002.97.
(Reporting By Sinéad Carew; Editing by Dan Grebler)
